notes:
A new flight deck: redesigned home, setup, settings, About and achievement cards.
Choose your jet and difficulty when starting a flight. Campaign difficulty stays locked.
Boss laser walls replaced with aimed, dodgeable volleys.
Weapon pickups retain your upgrade tier across all eight weapons.
Pin up to three achievement goals and see progress during flight, plus new-unlock badges in the menu.
Ultra graphics: original Blender scenery detail, soft shadows, richer reflections, supersampling and denser explosions.
30, 60, 90, 120 and Unlimited frame requests, subject to display and device support.
Android update checks, verified downloads and the normal Android installation confirmation.
Existing progress is preserved when updating. Harder-mode death penalties still apply.
